newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOUTH AFRICAN RIGHT WANTS SCHOOLYARD DEFENCE SQUADS.
newsitem.headline: SOUTH AFRICAN RIGHT WANTS SCHOOLYARD DEFENCE SQUADS.

text.p: The youth wing of South Africa's right-wing white Conservative Party (CP) urged white schoolchildren on Sunday to form self-defence units to fight off assaults and rapes by black pupils.
"Various incidents of violence, molestation and rape against white children have emerged recently," a statement said.
"The CP-Youth makes an urgent call on our children and youth at schools and on campuses to group themselves in self- protection units and learn first aid and self-defence."

The statement said parents should support their children in efforts to protect themselves from "these barbaric actions by blacks who do not have a grain of respect for property, human life or their education".
